§6Machine type: §a(Plasma / Electric) Arc Furnace / Fusion Reactor / Star Kernel Generator§r

" I closed my eyes and opened them again. "
" The rose didn't reappear, "
" but I knew it was there,"
" nestled in the amethyst vase."
The most elemental and ultimate utilization of energy.
The structure requires at least Infinity Coil.
Comprises four machine levels, Tier3 and Tier4 each unlocking a next mode.
With each machine tier upgrade, the lower-tier modes benefit from a 4x speed multiplier.
=== Machine Tier ===
The base structure is Tier 1
Gravitational Lens in the control slot unlocks Tier 2
Upgrade Chip in the control slot and utilizing Tier 2 structure unlocks Tier 3
Utilizing Advanced High Power Coil and then utilizing Teleportation Casing replacing Dimensional Bridge unlock Tier 4
=== Machine Mode ===
(Plasma / Electric) Arc Furnace
Parallel number = 2 ^ (Compact Fusion Coil Tier * (Coil Tier - 10))
(more in the controller's tooltip)

[note]Structure[/note]: Heating Coils (the coil tier matters); Tiered glass (limits the energy hatch tier); Superconductor UIV Base Frame Boxes; Neutronium Frame Boxes; Compact Fusion Coils; the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.
